cities.max: Indianapolis §743-306(W) permits up to 12 ADULT chickens/quail/pigeons/ducks COMBINED for qualifying personal accessory husbandry at single-/two-family residence without livestock license; more require approval.
cities.roosters: At most ONE rooster per lot and it must stay in a fully enclosed coop from dusk to dawn (§743-306(W)(5)).
cities.permit: No personal livestock license needed for standard eligible up-to-12 combined adult category-one birds; above that a personal livestock license may be required (§743-306(W)(3)-(4)). Other building/zoning permits separate.
cities.placement: No coops, roosts, pens or outside exercise areas in front yard; comply with actual zoning district setback and fencing/confinement requirements (§743-306(W)(7)); the code section gives NO universal numerical coop setback.
